capabilities: play 54 Vim training missions as throwaway notes edited with real Vim mode
track time, keystrokes, and XP with per-mission best scores
show character-precise hints and a searchable Vim cheatsheet
ask an LLM endpoint for in-character Vim advice and run debriefs (optional)
record keystroke traces of successful runs to a local file
disambiguation: Not a Vim-mode enhancement or an AI note-taking tool; it is a training game that uses the existing Vim mode to teach keybindings.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+; the README stresses that without Obsidian's Vim mode enabled the game 'rather misses the point'. Only the optional CIPHER uplink is labeled experimental. No network requests until an endpoint is configured; keystroke traces stay local unless a debrief is requested.
problem: Obsidian ships a Vim mode but nothing to learn or practice Vim motions inside the app.

relations.evidence: Optional, for Claude: the LLM Endpoint Manager plugin with a Claude entry
vim-dojo brings it back home as a first-class, standalone Obsidian plugin

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (LM Studio, Ollama, OpenRouter, ...) for the optional CIPHER feature
LLM Endpoint Manager, for the optional Claude uplink
API key for endpoints that require one or for Anthropic

summary: Vim training game that teaches Vim keybindings through 54 cyberpunk missions you complete by editing real Obsidian notes with the editor's Vim mode.
